messages:
Maya Chen: Hey all — thinking of hosting a small afterwork at the Riverview patio next Thursday. Dusk vibes, boardgames & snacks. Anyone in? Thinking 6pm start. Capacity ~20.
Jon Rivera: Love it. I'm in. Can we push to 6:30? Train gets in at 6.
Sara Patel: 6 or 6:30 works for me. I can bring veggie skewers and hummus.
Devin O'Neill: I'll bring Catan + Azul + Betrayal. Also a small Bluetooth speaker.
Katie Flores: Count me in. Any allergy notes? I'm happy to make mocktails (and non-alc options).
event-bot: Poll created — vote for date: :one: Wed May 14, :two: Thu May 15, :three: Fri May 16. React to vote.
Maya Chen: Quick spreadsheet for snacks/guests/equipment: https://rwd.in/sheets/xyz (add what you're bringing)
Jon Rivera: +1 guest — bringing Sam. Marked on sheet.
Devin O'Neill: Is there power near the patio if we want to warm a tray? No open flames, right?
facilities-bot: Patio notes: 2 external outlets near the bench. No open flames. Tables set for 20. If you need extra power, request a power strip from Facilities.
Katie Flores: Good to know — I'll skip anything with nuts (peanut allergy) but will label my drinks.
Sara Patel: Rain plan? Forecast shows a 30% chance.
Maya Chen: If it's raining we can move to 4th-floor lounge (I've confirmed with Ops). Will post update by 3pm day-of.
Devin O'Neill: Also happy to run a quick 'new players welcome' intro for Catan.
Jon Rivera: Bringing a foldable card table too if needed.
Maya Chen: Awesome — locking tentative date for Thu May 15 at 6:30 unless poll says otherwise. Thanks y'all! :sparkles: :game_die:
